description: This header file defines the interface for the RtXcastConnector class, which manages interactions with the xdial client using rtRemote. It includes method declarations for initializing remote communication, managing application states, enabling cast services, updating friendly names, registering applications, and handling callbacks related to remote service events.

classes.name: RtXcastConnector
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing remote interactions with the xdial client over rtRemote, including initializing communication, application management, and event handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up rtRemote communication with the rtDial server.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state changes, notifying the remote server with app name, state, id, and error info.

methods.name: enableCastService
methods.description: Enables or disables the Cast service with the given friendly name.

methods.name: updateFriendlyName
methods.description: Updates the friendly name for the cast service.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Registers a list of applications with the remote service.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol version used by the remote service.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the connector.

methods.name: connectToRemoteService
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the remote rtService.

methods.name: IsDynamicAppListEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the dynamic application list feature is enabled.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Assigns an RtNotifier service for callbacks.
